title: Lean In
idea: A little lean-in. A proper conversation.
rationale: The cupped hand and short voice bars show attentive capture; the mouth changes when Doddy speaks.
motion: Replace the capture bars and mouth only with voice-state updates.

title: Tiny Promise
idea: One small promise, kept one minute at a time.
rationale: A measured dial holds Doddy close to the countdown. The paused state keeps the same time and progress.
motion: Countdown and dial follow actual remaining time. Pause holds both.

title: Pocket Radio
idea: A tiny pocket radio, with Doddy on the dial.
rationale: Vinyl-like rings and a restrained orange needle make playback identifiable without an album cover.
motion: The orange record segment follows playback progress and holds when paused.

title: Here With You
idea: Here with you, without taking over.
rationale: Two small hands and a held conversation loop convey presence. Thinking replaces the active voice cue.
motion: Replace the conversation loop with thought points while processing.

title: Orbit
idea: A small instrument for a little momentum.
rationale: Three quiet ticks give the elliptical dial precision; one orange segment carries focus progress or voice activity.
motion: Dial segment follows progress; voice uses a bounded activity segment.

title: Ink Ripple
idea: Thoughts take shape before they become words.
rationale: An organic cream silhouette and an orange energy contour form one speech instrument, rather than a decorative waveform.
motion: Speech updates change the energy contour. Focus settles it into a quiet curve.

title: Negative Space
idea: The island becomes part of Doddy’s gesture.
rationale: A cream crescent cut from the island supports Doddy’s face and an offered hand. The black surface completes the gesture.
motion: The gesture stays still; the orange state point changes with useful updates.

title: Kinetic Ribbon
idea: Speech folds. Focus finds its line.
rationale: The ribbon wraps the identity and changes from a controlled speech fold to a measured focus loop.
motion: A bounded fold change follows voice-state updates. Focus has a stable measured loop.

title: Editorial
idea: Less illustration. More confidence. Still Doddy.
rationale: Large tabular numerals and a small character signature let the information do the work. A caret marks active capture.
motion: Numeric content changes stay on a fixed baseline; a caret indicates active capture.

title: Abstract Horizon
idea: A quiet horizon for the thing ahead.
rationale: Two cream contours form a horizon beneath Doddy. An orange marker indicates the active phase or timer progress.
motion: The horizon stays still; only the state/progress marker changes.

title: Thought Pocket
rationale: An orange thought token drops into a cream pocket. The proud face and offered hand turn completion into a Doddy moment.
motion: A short transition tucks the thought token into the pocket and reveals the saved check.

title: Language Bridge
rationale: Two dialogue shapes carry EN and FR. The crossing turns orange when the phrase is ready to hear.
motion: The crossing completes when the translation becomes ready. Hear it starts narration.

title: Reminder Knot
idea: Tie a little knot for later.
rationale: A cream reminder tag and a small orange knot connect setup to confirmation. The scheduled time stays primary metadata.
motion: The knot settles once when setup completes; the later reminder is a notification.

title: Step Stones
idea: Make the big thing a few smaller things.
rationale: Three stepping stones encode the plan. The orange first stone identifies the next step; the app contains the full breakdown.
motion: The active stone changes when a task step is completed.

title: Story Spool
rationale: An open paper spool and an orange word marker give read-aloud its own identity. Pause holds the marker in place.
motion: The orange word marker advances with narration; pause holds its position.

variants.label: PAUSED
variants.context: Pick up where you left off

title: Calm Tide
rationale: A tide line and phase arc support the literal In/Out labels. The face remains calm as the breathing phase changes.
motion: The tide and phase arc change with the breathing phase; keep explicit In/Out text with reduced motion.
